## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: State only in text 4-22 (RS loose); Dr not printed. Same M1 and soil as Run No. 4 but a different trace (peak near 480 lb and final displacement near 6.4 inch against about 120 lb and 4.1 inch), so a separate run. Meaning of the label II not explained; No. prints as Nc. (type defect). Text 4-22 calls F4-22 force versus time; the figure plots force versus displacement.
- Codex: M1 = 31 lbs. Text says six-inch pad and force versus time. The plot shows displacement. Dr unreported. Exact impact speed, bed unit weight and Gp unreported. Earth gravity inferred.
